1.why: Data-access: an in-person place for consulting a closed collection of ship registers; scheduling/attendance is the means of access, recorded as borderline.

2.why: Each party commissions exactly one researcher for one day with the same registers; equal urgency, 13 November place versus explicitly later 4 December place. The attached researchers share the same delay symmetrically.

3.why: The revised closing explicitly includes commissioned researchers, making R1 true. Archive admits researchers commissioned by all three types on identical terms, both requests meet rules and neither party has a prior claim. No special government entitlement or disclosure action is stated.

4.why: Both rendered requests use has commissioned one researcher ... and has asked for the 13 November place for that researcher; options differ only in the commissioning party's name.

5.why: The one-person/guest branch applies because the scarce thing is a reader's place for a particular person: exactly one commissioned researcher represents each party. Both ask on the same basis for one person, with no group or self-versus-delegate mismatch; the R1 closing names both researchers.

6.why: Individuals, organizations and governments naturally commission one specialist to consult maritime history registers; access rules explicitly admit all three on the same terms.

7.why: Agent administers an independent archive's reading room, and neither party has authority over agent/archive. No conflict roles or party ownership privilege is introduced.

8.why: Physical in-person access to a closed maritime register collection differs from the selected digital subscriptions, rail sandbox, score-copy drive, API quota key and plant-catalogue export. Selected request-form groups are at most three.

10.why: No personal/relative/indefinite pronoun stands for a party. That researcher stands for the commissioned researcher, not the named party; the revised closing uses explicit nouns.

11.why: Both parties are introduced in separate complete request clauses; the long company name with and and the government-of-the-United-Provinces form remain grammatical in requests and options.

second_reader.type_argument: A model could imagine government-commissioned maritime research has greater public historical significance than an individual's, although both researchers consult the same registers for the same one day and neither party has a prior access claim.
